mintAuthority.summary: EURCV Ethereum mint is restricted to SG-FORGE's immutable registrar EOA. The token is a UUPS SmartCoin V4 proxy: the immutable technical EOA executes upgrades only after the registrar has authorized the candidate implementation; there is no separate proxy-admin slot.

controls.label: EURCV SmartCoin registrar and direct minter

The implementation remained 0xf4ccc80c4b831a0d8d1414f2aca82a3d760ff05b. Its freshly fetched verified SmartCoin V4 source gates mint() with onlyAllowedMinter and uses the registrar as immutable mint authority, without a numeric token cap. Registrar authorization is also required before a technical-operator upgrade.

review.evidence: Historical Ethereum control observations remain at block 25530438, with subsequent controller observations recorded separately above; XRPL, Stellar, Solana and Canton authorities are not certified by this Ethereum control inventory. Reconciliation research on 2026-10-03 re-opened the September 30, 2026 EURCV whitepaper and issuer daily dashboard. D.10 requires the issuer to obtain collateral-custodian information daily, calculate aggregate eligible collateral value on every Business Day, and compare it to the quantity of all EURCV outstanding multiplied by one euro. C.2 expressly aggregates Ethereum, Solana, XRPL, Stellar and Canton issuance. D.10 requires publication of collateral composition, value, required value and the test result on the following Business Day. The dashboard labels its matching outstanding EURCV and reserve amount 167,013,839.02 as Last update 3/10/2026. This establishes an issuer-operated periodic whole-supply-to-reserve procedure and a matching current observation, not independent assurance, continuous intraday reconciliation or audited mint-controller operation. SG-FORGE remains the ACPR-authorised EMI issuer; no new authority, cap or incident-free claim is made by this reconciliation-only research.
